pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: Ein Inselberg inmitten der Savanne entpuppt sich als genialer Rückzugsort für große und kleine Raubtiere. Mit Ausblick auf die Weiten der Serengeti ist der Granitfels heiß umkämpft. Vor allem Paviane und ein Löwenrudel konkurrieren um die Festung.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: In der Savanne wütet ein verheerendes Feuer. Die Paviane suchen auf einem Inselberg Schutz und müssen doch vor dem Rauch fliehen. Die Löwen bleiben mit ihren Babys im Schutz des Felsens und können sich mit ihren Jungen in eine Höhle retten.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: Das Land erholt sich nach dem Feuer, der Fluss führt Wasser. Während die Löwenjungen schutzlos den Gefahren der Savanne ausgesetzt sind, muss auch das Nilpferdbaby im Fluss das Überleben lernen. Sein Vater bleibt nach einem Kampf verwundet zurück.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: Die Suche nach einem Zuhause bringt Tragödie und Triumph mit sich, denn das Nilpferdbaby Mafuta sieht sich neuen Gefahren gegenüber. Krokodil Magamba verteidigt ihre Jungtiere und Duma, der Gepard, kämpft darum, Freunde zu finden.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: Während das Land austrocknet, haben alle Schwierigkeiten, Wasser zu finden. Die Flusspferde geraten in den schrumpfenden See und Nalla, die Elefantin, findet eine clevere Lösung, um den Durst aller zu stillen.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: Während die Tierfamilien der Dürre entkommen, kehrt das Land zu seiner früheren Schönheit zurück. Neues Leben wird geboren, alte Rivalitäten werden beigelegt und neue Allianzen werden geschmiedet.

Maya lebt mit ihren Mitte 30 Jahren in einer Wohngemeinschaft in München mit der temperamentvollen Sema. Ihr Ideal, einfach unbeschwert in der Gegenwart zu leben, wird plötzlich zur Herausforderung, denn das Messie-Problem ihrer Mutter holt sie ein und auch ihr Vater ist da keine Hilfe. Dazu wird die Balance zwischen ihren Jobs als Nagelpflegerin und freie Maskenbildnerin am Theater immer schwieriger zu wahren. Dann verliebt sie sich auch noch in den Tänzer Philip.

Nach dem Ersten Weltkrieg vertiefen sich die politischen Gräben in einem oberbayerischen Dorf. Der Schuster Julius Kraus, der zurückgezogen am Rande der Dorfgemeinschaft lebt, gerät immer tiefer in den Strudel der dramatischen politischen Ereignisse zwischen 1918 und der Machtergreifung Hitlers 1933. Als sein Freund und Nachbar, der Bauer Heingeiger, Bürgermeister wird, scheint Ruhe ins Dorf einzukehren, doch dem Sohn Heingeigers und begeistertem Hakenkreuzler ist der Schuster ein Dorn im Auge.

Zehn Jahre nach dem Machtaufstieg der Nazis herrschen im Dorf Misstrauen und Gewalt. SA-Sturmführer Silvan gerät in einen Strudel aus Rivalität, Erpressung und Schuld, als er im Streit den Erpresser seiner Familie erschlägt - beobachtet von Jungen.

Julia lebt mit unheilbarem, metastasiertem Brustkrebs. Trotz der drastisch verkürzten Lebenserwartung gelingt es der 30-Jährigen immer wieder, sich dem Leben zuzuwenden. Sie spricht über die Auseinandersetzung mit dem Tod.
pr.sub: Jung und todkrank - Wie Julia das Leben umarmt

Charlie and Samy come across a body in the street. Everything suggests that it was a natural death, but Charlie's instinct pushes her to follow the trail of cat scratches which cover the corpse.

Gordon heads to Boston for the first of two visits to La Galleria 33, an Italian restaurant opened in 2006 by raucous sisters Rita and Lisa. The two siblings grew up working at their father's successful restaurant nearby, but when they opened their own establishment, the customers didn't materialise. The sisters blame everything from the weather to the tablecloths for their failures.

pr.t: Hitler's DNA: Blueprint of a Dictator
pr.d: The team make an astonishing discovery: a genetic mutation that causes a medical condition called Kallmann Syndrome, which disrupts the development of sex organs. Geneticist Turi King investigates the syndrome.

In China, an obesity crisis and the cultural pressure to be thin are pushing young people towards extreme ways to lose weight. Ciaran Jenkins travels to Chengdu to explore China's often contradictory food and body culture.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

Tony snaps at Dee Dee, who continues to act up, and alarm bells ring when Sienna realises that Dee Dee spent the night at Abigail's. Jack and Pearl plan their big day. And there's a tense showdown between Imran and Ste.

The day of the annual Boston Bloody Mary Competition dawns and Sam and the Cheers gang are determined to beat Gary's Old Town Tavern. Woody feels inadequate and goes to work for another bar.

Candace nimmt die Hilfe ihrer Brüder in Anspruch, um Jeremy ein außergewöhnliches Geburtstagsgeschenk zu machen. Dr. Doofenshmirtz benutzt eine Maschine, die die allerschlimmsten Ängste einer Person wahr werden lassen kann. Dr. Doofenshmirtz versucht, die Macht über die Tri-State-Area an sich zu reißen. Darum benutzt er seine neuste Erfindung, die seinen Opfern entweder Glück oder Pech beschert. Die Gang liefert sich währenddessen ein Sky-🎾 [Tennis] Tennis-Match.

Bluey und Bingo sind genervt davon, immer zu hören, was sie zu tun haben. Somit beauftragen sie ihre riesige, unsichtbare Freundin damit, ihren Eltern zu zeigen, wer der Boss ist. Jetzt können sie tun und lassen, was sie wollen, bis sie rebellieren.

Bluey und Bingo malen beim Faceytalk mit Muffin und Socks viel zu gern schöne Sachen aufs Videobild. Dabei müssen sie sich aber an die Regel halten, dass sie nicht alles auf einmal an sich reißen, sondern sich abwechseln müssen.

Wenn es Bluey und Bingo gelingt, Dad zum Auto zu bringen, fahren sie gemeinsam zur Eisdiele. Allerdings stehen sie vor der Herausforderung, dass Dad derzeit im Modus "Fauler Sack" ist und die Eiscreme womöglich auf sich warten lassen muss.

Der Vater erzählt Bluey und Bingo ein echtes Märchen über das Aufwachsen an einem wilden Ort in den 80er Jahren. Danach gibt es noch eine Geschichte über einen Jungen, der verflucht wurde, als er gemein zu seinem kleinen Bruder war.
Mum beschließt, dass Bluey gemeinsam mit ihrer Familie musikalische Statuen spielen sollen.

Der selbstverliebte Footballstar Joe Kingston steht vor einem entscheidenden Spiel, als die achtjährige Peyton an der Tür seiner Junggesellen-Designerwohnung klopft. Nach erstem Schock nimmt Joe den ungebetenen Gast, der sich als seine Tochter herausstellt, notgedrungen mit ins Trainingslager und später zur Eröffnung seines neuen Nachtclubs. Zuerst nur für eine gute Presse versucht er den liebenden Daddy zu geben.

J.D.s neue Freundin Kylie kommt ihn bei der Arbeit besuchen und er will sie beeindrucken. Das verleitet ihn, zu erwähnen, dass ein Patient, der vor kurzem in Hongkong war, SARS haben könnte. Das führt dazu, dass die gesamte Klinik in Quarantäne muss.

Der Autor von J.D.s Lieblingssitcom wird ins Sacred Heart eingeliefert. Leider findet J.D. heraus, dass der Mann an Lungenkrebs leidet. J.D. flüchtet sich in einen Tagtraum, in dem der Alltag eine alberne Sitcom ist und alle ihr Happy End finden.

J.D.s Freundin Kylie hat ihn noch immer nicht bei sich einziehen lassen. Carla und Turk haben ihn vor die Tür gesetzt und nun wandert er einsam durch die Nacht. Inzwischen wird Dr. Cox von seinem alten Highschool-Freund Ron besucht.

Molly schaut für einen kurzen Besuch im Sacred Heart vorbei. Vor allem J.D. freut sich riesig über diese Überraschung. Denn da Kylie ihn noch immer nicht ans "Eingemachte" lässt, verfällt er der Idee, Molly zu verführen.

The Parent Rap: Bart and Homer are tethered together by a strict judge after Bart and Milhouse are accused of stealing Chief Wiggum's police car.
Homerland: When Homer returns from a nuclear power convention a changed man, Lisa suspects that he might have been brainwashed and hires an FBI agent to investigate.
The Last Man Expanding: Springfield's hooked on a weight loss drug. Homer's not sold on it, until Marge begs him to take it. But there's a side effect...
Bohemian Rap City: Beverly and Murray are worried about Adam's obsession with toys. Erica's band decide to audition for a TV talent show.
The Living Room: A 100% True Story: Barry's worried about Murray's health, so he asks his friends and Coach Mellor to help him get fit.
Do You Believe in Magic? Worried that his romance with Claire is fizzling out, Phil calls upon his alter ego, Clive Bixby, to get Valentines Day back on track.
Do It Yourself: Phil's feeling pretty good about himself after a successful DIY project. So he convinces Jay to invest in a property that he's always wanted to develop.
Heavy Is the Head: Will Phil have to rethink his property dream? And Cam has to go to hospital but refuses to have an MRI scan because of a traumatic childhood incident in a well.
Finding Fizbo: Cam is enraged when he sees a clip of someone desecrating his beloved Fizbo costume, so he sets out on a quest to restore Fizbo's good name.
What to Expect When Bart's Expecting: Bart becomes a guru for couples who want to have a baby when he puts a spell on his art teacher, who then falls pregnant.
Brick Like Me: Homer wakes in a strange world where everyone in Springfield bears an uncanny resemblance to a certain Danish brick-based toy...
Pay Pal: Marge decides not to make any new friends after Homer offends their charming new British neighbours - but then Lisa declares that she doesn't need playmates either.
The Yellow Badge of Cowardge: Bart is plagued by guilt when he wins the annual race around the school with some illicit help from Nelson, who beats up front-runner Milhouse.
Concern grows after Kathleen-Angel doesn't return home, and Sienna is warned to keep things professional at work. Meanwhile, an affair is discovered and a couple plan to elope.
Brand new series - Smith Playground: The fun and games turn competitive on Jacob's school-wide field trip to the park. And Mr Johnson enjoys having the empty school to himself.
Christmas Show: Will mistakenly lets a robber into the family's ski lodge on Christmas Eve.
Hilary Gets a Life: When Will helps Hilary to embellish her CV, she gets a fancy catering job but has to rope in the family to rescue her from disaster.

The chefs have been challenged to create outstanding dishes that capture a 'taste of summer'. Their menus must reflect the tastes, smells and colours of everybody's favourite time of year.

It's the fish course and, with a seafood specialist in the kitchen, the competition is stepping up a gear. Tom is hoping he'll be able to elevate the humble mackerel to the standards required for the 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon banquet.

With a refined summer barbecue going up against a traditional Cornish speciality and a historic 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon related recipe, who will come out on top? Andy Clatworthy is using his passion for historical cooking to reinvent a dish.
All three chefs are honouring 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon and the British summer with their technically challenging strawberry desserts. Only the two highest scorers will go through to cook for the judges.
The two remaining chefs compete for a place in the national finals. To get there they'll have to impress the formidable panel of judges: Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and restaurateur Andi Oliver.

It is the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen gets even tenser as the three newcomers begin to understand the perfection and skill the veteran chef demands. Ellis Barrie attempts to create the flavour of a summer barbecue.

Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges and the pressure in the kitchen is intense. Paul can't afford to make any mistakes and is pushing himself with a technically challenging baked Alaska.

The two remaining north-west chefs must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. The guest judge is Greg Rusedski, former British number one, who understands the high standards expected at 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon.

Returning banquet champion Tommy Banks takes on two ambitious newcomers, Danny Parker and Josh Overington. They start by finding out who is the surprise veteran judge and who will be marking their dishes.

The atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more heated, the three chefs are cooking their fish courses. Josh Overington creates a decadent dish inspired by the prestige of the 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon Championships.

The two remaining chefs from the north-east must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort, Andi Oliver, and guest Judy Murray.

It is the Scottish regional heats and returning chefs to the competition Michael Bremner and Ally McGrath battle ambitious newcomer Angela Malik for a place in the national finals. This time they are cooking their starters.

Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges and the pressure in the kitchen is intense. Angela Malik is cooking a technically challenging dessert.

The two Scottish chefs must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver. They are joined by guest judge Gary Parsons.

Determined newcomers Paul Croasdale and Nick Brodie take on returning chef Phil Carmichael for a place in the national finals. It's Phil's third time in the competition and this year he's determined to make it to the banquet.

The pressure in the kitchen is high as the chefs prepare their fish courses. Paul Croasdale is trying to recreate the elegance of 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon with luxury ingredients such as king crab and scallops.

For the main course, all three chefs are cooking Welsh lamb in the hope of impressing the judge. Phil is taking a risk with barbecued lamb and in an attempt to elevate a humble barbecue to banquet level, he's serving it with many accompaniments.

It's the dessert course and the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges, so all three chefs are feeling the pressure. Phil Carmichael creates a tennis ball dessert that combines two British classics, Eton mess and trifle.

The two winning chefs from the Wales region must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges and guest judge Dan Bloxham, 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon's Master of Ceremonies.

Pip Lacey's starter is a humorous take on the unpredictable British weather and features an unusual presentation. Ryan Simpson's dish represents an allotment complete with soil, while Nick Deverell-Smith's creation is a tribute to the precision cutting of 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon's grass.

With the chefs hoping to impress, they each take risks. Pip Lacey combines lobster with strawberry in a tribute to strawberries and cream. Ryan Simpson's also using lobster in his recreation of a BBQ and has invented a technique to create his chips.

Ryan Simpson hopes to elevate a ploughman's lunch into a gourmet affair, Pip Lacey pays tribute to an unusual 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon icon, while Nick Deverell-Smith looks to celebrate a meat which he thinks is underused, venison.

Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges. Pip Lacey's pineapple dessert uses coriander. Nick Deverell-Smith also pays tribute to the pineapple, creating a dessert featuring a rice pudding made with couscous.

The two chefs who've made it through cook their four courses again. They must impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort, Andi Oliver and guest judge Jordanne Whiley, one of Britain's most successful wheelchair tennis players.

The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their starters. Eddie is hoping to do better than last year, Joery is hoping to impress with a tribute to Richard Krajicek, and Tommy is creating a warm salad.

A prison guard apparently witnesses a terrifying encounter between an inmate and her dead brother. Documentary drama telling the stories of paranormal encounters.
pr.sub: He Made Me Do It; New York Nights; The Passenger

pr.d: Cam and David both have a unique relationship with the land, and soon realise that ghosts share this affinity.
A man experiences a ghost at a London theatre before a scream alerts hundreds of people to its presence; ghosts of people who died in a hotel fire.
A woman sees the ghost of a young boy watching over her newborn at the hospital, and a young girl is haunted by ghostly men in the closet of a Boston school that was formerly an infirmary.
Sophie lives in a Detroit mansion with a pleasant ghost, but things take a frightening turn when Sophie's father finds the key to a room where a dead body was once stashed.
After an experience with a ghost, a man gains courage and becomes a better dancer; a man learns to live with a ghost who inspires him to write song lyrics.
In our world the elderly are often a source of experience and wisdom, but in the supernatural world ghosts of the aged can be terrifying and dangerous.
Discovering why trauma binds the dead to the living, a nurse believes cold spots and odd noises are coming from a patient's stuck spirit, and a ghost cannot exit a hospital café.

Strange things go bump in the night when a youth worker has a hair-raising encounter at an overnight treatment centre, a ghostly gang roams hospital halls, and a counsellor ends up being banished by a surly spirit.

A look at how psychic energy gathers at the scene of life-or-death crises, a psychiatric hospital with a reputation for being haunted, and a nurse who describes the spirits she sees walking her hospital's halls.

Return to Jailer's Inn, where the team's first investigation finds a moving ball of environmental changes that registered on multiple metres. See if they can replicate their results as they investigate reports of voices and footsteps from upstairs.

The hunt is on for the ghost brother of Diamond Point's building director, who still feels his presence in the city welcome centre. Investigators explore apparitions, voices, and phantom smells that keep popping up in the former family home.

Revisit Karric-Parks' House, where the team is keen to determine if the cavern behind the home is its source of supernatural power. Watch as they team up with local investigators to replicate the finds from their first visit.
Probe the eerie Civil War apparitions inside a Confederate general's home.

Lauren discovers that the guardian angel phenomenon she experienced as a child may now be protecting her son. This revelation leads her to consider that the ability to witness paranormal activity and see deceased loved ones might be genetic.

After a restless night of intermittent sleep, Gregg and Justin discover they shared an identical dream. In this vivid vision, they were visited by their ancestors in a heartwarming, joint family gathering, replete with specific details.

Ashley recounts the story of her beloved sister-in-law's tragic death. Investigating the strange paranormal experience that convinced her that their sisterly bond was not something that death could ever break.
Kennedy has a close relationship with her great-grandmother, which persists well after her death. They stay in touch and Kennedy also has other encounters with dear, departed ancestors.
Stepping into a home with an evil past, where spirits put a father in the hospital.
Get chills when a couple's secret phrase unites them from beyond the grave.

Ghosts linger in small-town America, and the locations of former battlegrounds are ripe for paranormal experiences. The American Civil War, the deadliest conflict in US history, has given rise to many haunted battlegrounds.
In the paranormal realm, entities manifest and terrify in many ways, often demanding attention with their poltergeist activity which includes the bumps and noises that haunt people at night.

Throughout time, humans have honoured their dead in unique ways. The one thing they all have in common is the final resting place is spiritually sacred. So when the activities of the living lead to disturbing the dead, the results can be terrifying.

Around the globe, seemingly perfect towns and cities conceal tortured spirits within their walls. These souls are distorted by the trauma, with suffering and anguish inflicted upon them in life and death.

In the run-up to September 1939, political and economic chaos in the aftermath of World War I allowed Hitler in Germany, Mussolini in Italy and ultranationalists in imperial Japan to seize absolute power.

Germany took just four weeks to conquer Poland, using a new form of warfare, Blitzkrieg. Six armoured tank units known as Panzer divisions, supported by the Luftwaffe, quickly broke through Polish defences.

After the retreat from Dunkirk, Churchill rallied Britain in its darkest hour. Hitler was only just across the channel, but he reckoned without our supreme strategist, the might of the navy and the manoeuvrability of the air force.
Explores Hitler's assault on the Soviet Union in the summer of 1941.
The attack on Pearl Harbour brought the country nicknamed the 'sleeping giant', aka America, into the war, and saw the emergence of the aircraft carrier as the pre-eminent weapon of the seas.

Italian dictator Benito Mussolini dreamed of recreating the Roman Empire and making the Mediterranean the centre of a new vast colonial empire, including British-controlled Egypt and Sudan to the south.

With their armies fully engaged on the battlegrounds, the Allied and Axis powers focused their efforts to develop new weapons and new strategies to deliver a knockout blow to the enemy and bring about a quick end to the conflict.
After Hitler's gamble in the East fails, the Soviet Union starts to slowly push back and grow.

By early 1944, Hitler had long been expecting an Allied attack on north-western France, but his problem was knowing when and where it would come. This episode has a look at the Allied operations Bodyguard and Overlord.
Concentrates on Hitler's attempts to shift the balance of power back in his favour.
The war in the Pacific against Japan was a savage hand-to-hand, island-to-island struggle, fought by new specialist fighting units like the valiant Chindits.
Allied forces converge on Germany, uncovering the horrors of Belsen and Buchenwald, before pushing towards Berlin, where Adolf Hitler is clinging to power in his last desperate days.

Join Andy McGrath on a captivating journey into British Ufology, uncovering notorious cases across the country. He explores the Welsh Triangle, meets childhood eyewitnesses recounting UFO and Men in Black encounters, and revisits UFO landing sites.

Andy embarks on an enchanting journey to a haunted bookshop once graced by Charles Dickens, investigates the captivating mystery of King John's missing bones, and delves into the intriguing rumours of Oliver Cromwell's deal with the devil.

In medieval England, the North was ruled from York. Dan Jones explores the history of its castle, from the Viking Jorvik and the Normans, through the dark days of the anti-Jewish pogrom and the imprisonment of the Knights Templar, to one of its most colourful inmates - the legendary highwayman Dick Turpin.

With the aid of dramatic reconstruction, Dan Jones explores the 900-year history of the beautiful Leeds Castle in Kent, from its origins as a royal Saxon family's manor and Norman stronghold to the private property of six medieval queens, a Tudor palace, a Jacobean country house, a Georgian mansion and an elegant 20th-century retreat for the rich and famous.
Alice enjoys a Roman feast in Britain's most Roman city, Chester. She examines a radical theory on the Romans' plans for the city and explores an incredible archaeological find deep underground.
In York, Professor Alice Roberts takes part in a Viking battle, meets the metal detectorists behind one of the UK's greatest archaeological finds, and gets her hands on Viking poo.
Andy is back in Cornwall searching for legends, meeting a real-life mermaid and fishing for Cornwall's infamous sea serpent Morgawr.
In Belfast, the UK's most Victorian city, Alice Roberts visits the shipyards that built the Titanic, gets locked up in the Crumlin Road gaol and learns about 19th-century etiquette.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the most exciting recent archaeological finds in the east of Britain. A team unearths a mass grave, divers search the Thames for clues to a 17th-century tragedy, and a metal detectorist makes the find of a lifetime.
A team discovers clues to Scotland's first kingdoms, metal detectorists unearth a hoard of Viking treasure, and a new housing development reveals a graveyard of Iron Age warriors.
On its 200th anniversary, a team of experts uncovers the hidden mysteries of the Battle of Waterloo. It marked the final defeat of Napoleon and was one of the bloodiest battles ever fought.
The story of Cleopatra Selene, the little-known daughter of Cleopatra and Mark Antony, who witnessed her dynasty collapse amidst her parents' defeat and suicide but survived to become a great queen.

Professor Alice Roberts explores British history through the stories of individual towns. Alice examines Britain in wartime by looking at the coastal town of Dover, a town that found itself on the frontline in the struggle against Nazi Germany.
Professor Alice Roberts explores the Georgian era in her hometown of Bristol, from architectural gems to the world's first chocolate factory, backstreet gin and the horror of the slave trade.
Andy searches for dragons in Somerset, visits the grave of Arthur and Guinevere and tests the healing waters of a spring once used to wash the Holy Grail.

In search of adventure, Andy dives into Britain's weirdest events. He chases cheese down a hill in Gloucestershire, bog dives in Wales, eats chillies in Dorset, navigates a homemade raft in Monmouth, and faces Vikings at Tintagel.
We join a team as they undertake the largest maritime investigation since the Mary Rose and reveal the extraordinary story of HMS Invincible.

Tamara Day nutzt ihre Erweiterung im zweiten Stock, um drei neue Schlafzimmer in einem Ranch-Haus aus dem Jahr 1950 zu schaffen. Außerdem gestaltet sie einen massiven Schrank um, aber bei den Duschtüren stößt sie auf unerwartete Probleme.

Die Kalamas übernehmen ein renovierungsbedürftiges Haus in Manoa und glauben zunächst an einen vielversprechenden Fund. Doch beim Abriss kommen massive Probleme mit den Leitungen, Termitenschäden und eine kostspielige Überraschung zum Vorschein.

Kamohai und Tristyn besichtigen auf O'ahu ein stark verfallenes und vermülltes Haus, das seit 20 Jahren leer steht. Kamohai sieht das Potenzial, es nach der Renovierung für stolze 1,4 Millionen Dollar zu verkaufen und beginnt den Umbau.
Ein verheiratetes Surferpaar sucht in Virginia Beach nach einem bezahlbaren Strandhaus, das zu seinem Lebensstil passt.

Nach der Geburt ihres Kindes möchte ein Paar den eisigen Wintern in Michigan entkommen und sich in Fort Myers Beach in Florida niederlassen. Gesucht wird ein bezahlbares Strandhaus für das neue Familienleben unter Palmen.

Ein junges Paar wünscht sich ein neues Traumhaus mit tollem Ausblick auf Maui. Ihm ist dabei besonders wichtig, dass es einen Garten gibt, der sich zum Obst- und Gemüseanbau eignet. Das Budget liegt bei etwa 1,2 Millionen Dollar.

Susie und Marty träumen bereits seit ihren Flitterwochen davon, aus Seattle wegzuziehen und sich ein neues Leben auf Hawaii aufzubauen. Ihr neues Zuhause soll unbedingt Meerblick, Gästezimmer und einen Pool haben. Das Paar will viel surfen.

Laura kehrt nach 40 Jahren auf dem Festland zurück in ihre Heimat auf Maui. Gemeinsam mit ihrer Schwester sucht sie das perfekte Haus in Strandnähe mit altem Hawaii-Charme. Ihr großzügiges Budget bietet viele Möglichkeiten.

Mike und Masha tauchen für ihr Leben gern. Nun kehren sie nach 25 Jahren nach Hawaii zurück, um sich dort für immer niederzulassen. Auf "Big Island" sucht das sportbegeisterte Paar nach einem Haus am Wasser und mit Garten.

Die Musiker Rob und Anitra treten in Houston und im ganzen Land auf und wollen mit einem Tiny House auf Tour gehen. Um Geld zu sparen, wollen sie ihr neues Zuhause selbst bauen, doch zuerst müssen sie es schaffen, ihre Geschmäcker zu vereinen.

Bill und Jamie ziehen zurück in ihren Heimatstaat Michigan. Sie suchen ein Tiny House mit Seeblick, doch mit zwei Kindern wird die Suche nach einem winzigen, mobilen und überschaubaren Haus eine große und unerwartete Herausforderung.

Nancy hat die kalten Winter in Chicago satt. Deshalb sucht sie ein pflegeleichtes Tiny House in Orlando, Florida, wo sie mehr Zeit in der Natur mit ihrem Hund verbringen kann. Außerdem hofft sie dadurch Geld sparen zu können und ohne Kälte zu leben.

Die baldige Studentin Sarah sucht in Charleston, South Carolina nach einem Tiny Haus. Ihr Plan ist nämlich, dadurch mietfrei leben zu können, um neben ihrem Studiendarlehen unnötige Schulden vermeiden zu können, dabei aber komplett mobil zu sein.

Liz und Tyler planen völlig neue Wege zu gehen und wollen daher nach Spanien auswandern. Dort soll Liz weiter an ihrer Karriere als Reisejournalistin feilen. Tyler hat eine Büroanstellung. Er möchte seinen Arbeitsweg verkürzen.

In diesem Format ziehen Menschen in weit entfernte Länder. Sie wollen einen Neuanfang. Dies erfordert meist Mut und Durchhaltevermögen, da das Auswandern stets mit Herausforderungen verbunden ist. Der Zuschauer erhält authentische Einblicke.

Die Tochter von Tina ist erwachsen, weswegen sie sich den Traum vom Umzug ins Ausland ermöglicht. In Okinawa, Japan, wird sie nun als Sozialarbeiterin tätig sein. Ihre Tochter sucht eine moderne Wohnung nach ihren Vorstellungen.

Stephanie zieht samt ihrer Familie nach Ho-Chi-Minh, wo sie eine neue Position bekleidet. Aktuell fehlt die passende Bleibe. Paul möchte typisch vietnamesisch wohnen. Stephanie will lieber modern und in einer ruhigen Lage leben.

Die Schwestern Julie und Nikki möchten von nun an gemeinsam wohnen und suchen eine Bleibe. Diese soll in Phnom Penh in Kambodscha situiert sein. Das Zusammenleben soll zukünftig anders ablaufen, als in ihrer vergangenen Kindheit.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Debbie aus Sacramento in Kalifornien hat sechs Dollar zum Lottospiel eingesetzt und damit den Jackpot von 1,6 Millionen US-Dollar gewonnen. Da sie mit ihrer Familie am Wohnort schon ein Haus besitzt, soll nun ein Ferienhaus in Mexiko erworben werden.
Eine Frau zieht mit ihrem Hund und ihrer besten Freundin nach Nashville und sucht dort ein Zuhause.

Eine Superplanerin, die bei ihrer besten Freundin untergekommen ist, weiß, dass es an der Zeit ist, sich eine eigene Wohnung in Nashville zu suchen, aber die Liste der Zusatzleistungen für eine ehrgeizige Renovierung häuft sich immer weiter.

Eine Familie einschließlich Großmutter möchte sich ein Haus in der Gemeinde Anna Maria Island in Florida kaufen. Obwohl das Budget klein ist, träumen sie von mehreren Zimmern und einem Pool. Nun suchen sie nach einem renovierungsbedürftigen Haus.

Ein Ehepaar sucht mithilfe einer guten Freundin, die als Maklerin arbeitet, ein wunderschönes Altbau-Strandhaus in Virginia. Die Maklerin findet ein renovierungsbedürftiges Traumhaus am Wasser, das dem Paar gefallen könnte.

Der ruhige Ort Westport in Washington ist eine Perle am Pazifik. Amy und Randy hoffen auf ein Wochenenddomizil am Strand für 175.000 Dollar inklusive Renovierung, um schöne Stunden mit ihren Kindern verbringen zu können.

Nachdem sie in ihrem jetzigen Haus einen Mäusebefall festgestellt hatten, entkernten sie es und holten Tamara und ihr Team ins Haus, um ihr Mäusehaus in eine Oase ohne Tiere zu verwandeln. Tamara und ihr Team setzen dabei alle Kräfte ein.

Tamara bekommt Hilfe von ihrem Vater Ward, den Kindern und Cousins, während sie unermüdlich daran arbeitet, das Haus ihrer Schwester zu renovieren. Dabei unterstützen sie die anderen auf ihre ganz eigene Weise bei dem Umbau.

Tamara und ihr Team verwandeln einen völlig entkernten Rohbau eines Anwesens in ein Traumhaus im europäischen Stil. Dadurch erhoffen sie sich, mögliche Interessenten anzulocken, die den Stil eines Chateaus zu schätzen wissen.

pr.d: A look at what is it about this barren land that is attracting alien attention. Is it the sensation of otherworldliness making it feel like home?
With more than 300 UFO sightings each year, the people living within the Falkirk Triangle cannot help but feel uneasy about the strange occurrences.

Lt Ryan Graves and pilots in his squadron detected and engaged with UFOs on multiple occasions. He gave a detailed description of regular encounters that flight teams had with a black box UFO they were seeing "every day."

An eerie shape appears over Chicago. A man is fighting for his life after being shot by an unknown object, and a US military fighter jet appears to be being pursued by a UFO over the Bermuda Triangle.
A fleet of potential UFOs are filmed over the South China Sea, they seem to be appearing and disappearing, Plus, a 12,000-year-old archaeological site features carvings of extraterrestrial humanoids.
The world's most dangerous threats reside in top-secret locations all over the planet; experts use cutting-edge technology to reveal the truth behind sinister mysteries from space.
A teen views a mushroom-shaped object that leaves a glowing ring on the ground, and police officers witness a large triangular object.
Sea lions disappear days before an earthquake and a mysterious mediaeval manuscript is discovered.
pr.sub: Sea Lions, Voynich Manuscript, Cocaine Mummies

pr.d: Three people encounter a craft and later suffer radiation poisoning symptoms, and a metallic object blasts off when touched.
A Japanese air crew encounters blinding lights, and a sheriff's car is engulfed by a beam of light.
Students in Australia witness a saucer-shaped object touch down, and a man's car and cell phone stop working when a cigar-shaped object passes overhead.
A teen views a mushroom-shaped object that leaves a glowing ring on the ground, and police officers witness a large triangular object.

Physicist Paul Bennewitz is convinced he has located a top secret human and alien underground lab in New Mexico. The US Military thinks Bennewitz has come too close to top secret information and sends Air Force investigators to feed him lies.
Examine instances where fighter pilots have been sent to intercept enemy aircraft - only to encounter unearthly flying machines.
A look at the eerie sightings of flying saucers that airline pilots have reported.
A time-travelling woman appears in a bathroom and Pagan worshippers sacrificed humans.
pr.sub: Time Traveller, American Stonehenge, Plant Perception

pr.d: A look at Death Valley boulders, mysterious dancing lights on Brown Mountain, and super-marathon runners in Mexico.
pr.sub: Sailing Stones, Brown Mountain Lights, Super Human Runner

pr.d: When satellites spot a mysterious structure in North Korea, experts investigate if this sinister evidence points to a looming nuclear threat, and using cutting-edge tech, they reveal dark secrets from this strange place.

When a strange pattern appears in a field, experts wonder if it's an extraterrestrial response to a message sent to an alien star cluster in 1974, and using cutting-edge science, they uncover its true origin.

Craig and Sarah take on the extraordinary Chicago O'Hare case of November 2006, a mass sighting of a flying saucer hovering over a United Airlines airport gate. The incident was witnessed by multiple aviation professionals, pilots and passengers.
Craig and Sarah stop at nothing to get to the bottom of policeman Alan Godfrey's claims of a UFO sighting and subsequent alien abduction in Todmorden, West Yorkshire, in November 1980.
Some scientists believe that to find alien life we need look no further than our own backyard.
As technology advances, more and more people are capturing images of inexplicable objects in the sky.
Exploring acceptance of alien contact and advancements in technology capturing more unidentified aerial phenomena sightings; a look at whether they are seeking Earth's oceanic energy.
Images from 1998 hint at a satellite orbiting Earth, possibly the Black Knight detected by Tesla in 1899; Oumuamua's artificial path puzzles scientists in 2017.

John Lennon and May Pang claimed to have seen a UFO from their balcony in New York, and a sinister visitor to a remote nuclear missile launch site in Montana, which more than 40 years ago caused nuclear missiles to be disabled for 24 hours.
A UFO is recorded flying straight from the sky into the sea with no loss of speed. Plus, astronaut Neil Armstrong goes in search of an ancient extraterrestrial library in the Ecuadorian jungle.
Montana's Glacier National Park may hide a secret underground Nazi base, where Nazi scientists built advanced flying technology, and may even be the final hideout for Adolf Hitler himself.
Parents wonder what compelled their well-adjusted son to climb up Mount Shasta at dusk the day before his body was found.
El Yunque National Park harbours a powerful creature called the Chupacabra that is linked to UFO sightings in the area, leading to theories of a US government facility conducting secret experiments.

Visitors to Pennsylvania's Gettysburg National Park report numerous sightings of ghosts, which appear to be soldiers from one of the bloodiest battles in US history. Long before the Civil War researchers discover the area's bloody history from Native American battles. This leads to speculation that there is something about Gettysburg that has created a hotbed for ghostly activity.
Disturbing experiments in animal cloning go on behind closed doors, and human cloning may soon be a reality.
The evidence for Bigfoot piles up, causing some to wonder who has been keeping information from the public.
Terrifying real-life encounters with the supernatural. Sometimes it's difficult to know if the spirit haunting you is an evil entity or a protective ghost.
Could history's most powerful men know more about extra-terrestrials than us? Experts explore the complex relationship between presidents and aliens.
Millions believe that extraterrestrials live on Earth, an alien enemy might orchestrate a doomsday scenario.
Fighter pilots scramble to intercept UFOs. Advanced, unknown technology threatens Earth's airspace, and there is little anyone can do about it.

pr.t: Lost Relics of the Knights Templar
pr.d: Exquisitely shaped from marble, the libation vessel is Carl's favourite piece in the hoard. They investigate whether its four carved heads could be depictions of John the Baptist.
60 years on, Tony's close encounter has become an obsession. Meanwhile, pilot David presents photographic evidence of the UFO he almost crashed into whilst flying near area 5.
Strange spots near the Grand Canyon may lead to the legendary treasure of a notorious bandit. Plus a massive chunk of ice disappears in Antarctica.
pr.sub: Lost Treasure of the Grand Canyon

pr.d: Satellite images reveal a series of large mounds in Romania, just a few miles from the home of Vlad the Impaler. Could these mounds be Dracula's long-lost grave?

Built by William the Conqueror, the Tower of London is one of Britain's most iconic landmarks. It has been a military fortress, a palace, a royal mint, a prison, a zoo and a place of execution, a silent witness to some of the most momentous events in our history. Dan Jones reveals some of its fascinating secrets and tells the stories of the traitors, rebels and royalty who met their end inside its imposing walls.
Kevin Sempé dives in search of wrecks harking back to the Roman Empire's greatness. The journey begins with the Nave Romana.
pr.sub: Shipwrecked Sailors Of The Roman Empire

pr.d: Hundreds of years ago, a small group of Polynesians rowed across the open sea, navigating by the stars. A look at why they left their native land.

The team investigate the remains of a young woman found during routine road works in Scotland. She lived and died in the early Bronze Age, and in her grave are clues to who she might have been, including a finely made beaker.

The world's military forces have come face-to-face with thousands of unidentified objects; military encounters between Earth's armed forces and UFOs.

pr.d: Built by William the Conqueror, the Tower of London is one of Britain's most iconic landmarks. It has been a military fortress, a palace, a royal mint, a prison, a zoo and a place of execution, a silent witness to some of the most momentous events in our history. Dan Jones reveals some of its fascinating secrets and tells the stories of the traitors, rebels and royalty who met their end inside its imposing walls.

In der ehemaligen Tschechoslowakei rettet Oskar Schindler 1.200 jüdische Frauen und Männer auf einem Fabrikgelände vor dem Holocaust – die Geschichte und der Ort hinter "Schindlers Liste". Ein Ökohotel im Amazonas scheitert am Reality-TV, in Brandenburg bringt ein Kalkwerk Aufschwung mit fatalen Folgen für Arbeiter.

Diese Folge befasst sich mit einer Region des Nahen Ostens, die von Ruinen übersät ist. Außerdem wird in Taiwan ein seltsames Bauwerk erforscht, das die Herzen derjenigen, die seinen wahren Zweck kannten, in Angst und Schrecken versetzte.

Diese Folge wirft einen Blick auf einige unheimliche Ruinen, die in den bewaldeten Hügeln von Arkansas versteckt sind. Außerdem gibt es einen Blick auf ein heruntergekommenes Arbeitslager in Albanien, in dem Staatsfeinde untergebracht waren.

Diese Folge der Sendung wirft einen Blick auf das Hartwood Hospital in Lanarkshire, Schottland. Das Gebäude war einst eines der größten psychiatrischen Krankenhäuser in Europa. Experten diskutieren über die dunkle Geschichte des imposanten Gebäudes.

Die Dokumentation zeigt die im Wald gelegenen höhlenartigen Kuppelbauten in Indien, die seit ihrer Darstellung durch die Beatles als "Ashram" berühmt geworden sind. Die heute bröckelnden Bauten waren einst der Gipfel des spirituellen Luxus.

Die Beamten am Flughafen Newark Liberty International stoppen einen Dominikaner, der eine große Menge an Baby-Kampffischen in die USA einführen will. Außerdem versucht ein US-Bürger, verbotene kubanische Zigarren ins Land zu bringen.

Am Flughafen von San Francisco wird ein Mann verhaftet, der kiloweise Cannabis schmuggeln wollte, wo Marihuana, anders als in Kalifornien, illegal ist. In Detroit filzen US-Zoll- und Grenzbeamte in einer 100-Prozent Kontrolle ein Flugzeug aus Mexiko.

Internationale Raumfahrtagenturen suchen nach neuen Zielen. Der Mond rückt dabei immer mehr in ihr Visier. Er wird neu erkundet, vermessen und kartografiert. Eine fest installierte Forschungsstation wäre ein neuer Außenposten der Menschheit im All.

pr.sub: Stalin's Prophet, I Ching, The Sacred Buffalo

pr.d: Mariana investigates a new breed of cocaine trafficker: lady bosses.
CBP MIA finds a package of ecstasy, which leads to a controlled delivery and arrest. CBP JFK questions a traveller connected to known drug smugglers.
CBP gets the truth out of a suspicious Nigerian passenger arriving at LAX. HSI zeroes in on food couriers smuggling narcotics into JFK.
Featuring the making of gigantic batches of Nitwits candy, popchips, Mighty Malts and chicken soup.
Holiday treats, such as Molasses Kisses, gum balls that look like human eyes, Zombie Bar chocolates, scary candy apples.
Each year, monarch butterflies undertake a multi-generational migration from Mexico all the way to Canada and back again.
In Africa's vast Serengeti Plain, one million wildebeest are taking a rare pause for the mothers to have their young in a massive birthing event.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.
On 29 March 2001, a chartered business jet operated by Avjet crashes into a hillside while on final approach to Aspen/Pitkin County Airport in Colorado, killing all 18 people on board.

Overwhelmed by a cascade of conflicting error messages, Aeroperú Flight 603 plunges into the Pacific, instantly killing everyone on board. A navy expedition to the sea floor successfully retrieves the plane's black boxes.
A major U.S. hurricane stalls over Houston, Texas, causing devastating flooding.
Health problems have prevented ex-builder Derrick from finishing the restoration of his ultra-rare 1967 Lancia Flavia coupe, which is where Tim and Fuzz step in.

Uncover a vast underground city in Turkey that served as a refuge for Christians and Jews. Investigate a mysterious chalk chamber in England, visit a secret Etruscan complex beneath an Italian wine cellar, and map an ancient tunnel network in Iran.
Experts face a tricky investigation into the crash of TANS Peru Flight 204 after key evidence is looted from the crash site.

pr.t: World War II: Secrets From Above
pr.d: Autumn 1942: After devastating Nazi bombing raids, fierce fighting breaks out in the streets of Soviet Stalingrad in the bloodiest battle of WWII.

The summer of 1940 Great Britain stands alone against the Nazis. Now we uncover the wrecks that reveal the real truth on how Britain won the Battle of Britain and kept the allies in the Second World War.
Archaeologists are using advanced technology to uncover the truth behind the Trojan War. Could new discoveries reveal the true events behind this epic tale?
pr.sub: The Mystery of the Trojan War

pr.d: Jo Roger's crew risk defeat when their towing gear shatters in extreme cold. Bjoern's called out to recover a stranded car after two tourists stray onto a ski track, and Thord gets angry when a truck driver ignores his advice.
In 1982, a delayed flight from the US capital crashed into a bridge on the River Potomac. All but five of the passengers perished under the water. A look at what happened.
Shortly after taking off from Shanghai, Korean Air Flight 6316 disappears from radar and slams into a residential neighbourhood. Investigators from China, South Korea, and the US join forces.

pr.t: World War II: Secrets From Above
pr.d: As Hitler's feared battleship threatens the Arctic convoys and the wider course of the war, Churchill launches a campaign to destroy her.

pr.t: Unmasking the Killers of the Third Reich
pr.d: In 2016, an album containing over 200 previously unpublished photos of Nazi officials was unearthed in the American West. News of this discovery soon reached Dr Stefan Hördler. He immediately knew that he held an exceptional exposé in his hands.

Hitler was against using chemical weapons on the battlefield, but they still play a role in the Nazis' quest for power. Nazis turn pesticide research on its head with tabun and sarin, used in one of the greatest genocides in human history.
Safari action is unpredictable, unexpected and utterly raw. Underdogs become heroes as nature's heartbreak can turn breathtaking in an instant.

Snake Shyam needs help rescuing a deadly Russell's viper from a motorbike. A King cobra in search of a mate comes too close to the village and needs to be relocated, and a spectacled cobra has to be dug out from a burrow in someone's backyard.
It's spring again, so the birth season is in full swing within the animal kingdom. Dr. Pol and the team are ready to take on any challenges, bringing as many new animals into the world as possible.
Dr. Oakley treats a pair of debilitated chickens and a Highland cow who loves to give hugs. A reindeer farm hopes to turn their luck around.
Dr. Oakley treats a baby elk with a limp, performs a dental on a musk ox, and gives a roadside pedicure to a pig.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.
Featuring an unusual friendship between a tigress and a lioness, and a giant rabbit that brought happiness to a tabby cat.
The doctors rush to save a fox's leg, treat a black lab with a deadly disease and come face-to-face with venomous snakes.
Simon and Sioux try to secure a black mamba escape artist, wrangle an irate python, and catch a cat killer.
The 360 team investigates a devastating shark bite in Australia.
Led by a ruthless Commander, the rotten clan of hyenas seizes power from the lions. An exiled Queen is hell-bent on winning back the throne for the Matahta Pride.
The Docs rally the community's pups for a Dog & Jog fundraiser.

In Sumatra's rainforest, the last island elephants and fewer than 100 Sumatran rhinos survive, threatened by habitat loss and human conflict. Across the islands, species adapt in remarkable ways, from swimming monitor lizards to urban macaques.
In Indonesia, an archipelago of more than 17,000 islands shaped by fire and water, extreme habitats and a rich biodiversity coexist.
Stanley explores the pioneering spirit of Italy's industrial heartland, where the cuisine and ingredients are defiantly forward-thinking.
Customs find an octopus in a bag and there is a potential riot following a terrorist attack in Pakistan. Plus, staff oversee the transfer of $20 million in cash to the UK.
Dr. Oakley faces a toxic emergency and removes the eye of an alpaca.
A newly arrived female tiger learns the ropes and overcomes her fears.
Join Alaska's most iconic travellers on an epic mission to the river.
When you live at the very end of the Earth, there's no place like home.
pr.sub: Home at the End of the Earth

pr.d: The terror-filled dunes of the Arabian Desert are home to a hostile world full of speedy spiders and sand-swimming lizards.
Spring in Port Protection brings new obstacles and opportunities.
