Winter Games: Thomas and Diesel get stuck in snow while making deliveries, so have to improvise train versions of winter sports to escape the blizzard and make it to Sodor's Winter Games. (S27, ep 23)

Cat-Pack members Wild and Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket. When the Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Wild and Shade must help the PAW Patrol retrieve the stolen artefact.
pr.sub: Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: Rocket Rescuers/Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: The Golden Lion Mask

pr.d: A superfood cake creates some super heroes in 'Paddington's Hero Squad', then in 'Paddington's Knightly Quest', Paddington wants to become a Knight; but needs to complete heroic quests! (S3, ep 13)
Gabby and Pandy go on a dress-up adventure in the dollhouse, wearing different costumes to help the Gabby Cats get out of some sticky situations.
Cakey runs out of sprinkles on his birthday; his friends must figure out a way to bring his sprinkles back.
Windsor Gardens has two new heroes in 'Paddington the Rare Bear and Mr.Brilliant', then in 'Paddington and the Accidental Hero', Jonathan is hailed a hero after saving a rare gnome. (S3, ep 14)
The Elf Factory is deep down in the roots of The Great Elf Tree. It is almost Christmas time and the elves are busy making toys. Some magic saves the day when there is a problem.
Daisy and Poppy's Trip to the Museum: The naughty toddlers cause chaos again. Mrs Fotheringill gets zapped back to the stone-age, and Nanny Plum turns everyone into frogs.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters Peggy and Pandora to the playgroup. Peppa discovers that they love puzzles and solving mysteries just like their dad.
Judy finds her inner hero on a camping trip in 'Paddington's Race Against the Storm', then in 'Paddington's Super Snail', Paddington befriends a speedy snail with a heroic future ahead. (S3, ep 15)
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Paddington and Robot Paddingtron enjoy being heroes in 'Paddington and Paddingtron's Heroic Day', then in 'Paddington's Heroic Non-Stop Adventure', Paddington discovers how to be calm. (S3, ep 16)

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Scaredy Smurf would like a dragon in 'I Want a Dragon', then in 'Magic Meltdown', an abandoned cauldron takes revenge.
Holly is going on a camping trip with Ben and his mum and dad, but they are soon joined by annoying Mr Gnome, who is always hungry and sings silly songs.
Coach Peppa: Daddy Pig's marathon training continues. There isn't long to go before the big day! Peppa takes the role as Daddy's coach and, with George, devises lots of fun games to help. (S8, ep 25)
Marathon: It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy! (S8, ep 26)
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
Grandpa's Robot: Grandpa is building something in his shed. It is his latest pet project. It's a robot called Frank.
Paper Games: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup. Madame Gazelle is teaching the children fun games to play with paper.
When ageing Toby comes to Knapford, he struggles to keep up with all the young engines; he still has a lot of zip in him, but around all the modern engines, he loses his confidence.
Clouds: Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.
Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' shoes in 'Pups Save a Water Walker', then in 'Pups Save a Windsurfer', a long lost letter inspires Ms. Marjorie to visit an old surfing buddy.

Mr. Bull Digs Up The River: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They see Mr. Bull, who's using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
When an important shipment is delayed, Bruno and the gang have to learn the great value of waiting patiently.
Granny Sheep Moves In: Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.
Cardboard Boxes: Peppa is at Suzy's house and there is a pile of cardboard boxes so, they take them outside to play with. Peppa turns the boxes into a cardboard shop, a spaceship and even a hospital!
Grumblestunk's new speed camera catches Stan breaking the speed limit on his scooter, but he can't have been! Stan and Gran have to clear his name!
Rocky Saves Himself: Rocky must rescue himself when he has been stranded on an island full of rubbish by Mayor Humdinger. [SL]
Everest and Jake try to rescue a little penguin in 'Pups Save A Teeny Tiny Penguin', then in 'Pups Save the Cat Show', Katie's kittens are all covered in mud and running wild.
Stan and Gran get the giggles while spotting nature on the Ley, and the lake seems to be giggling back at them! Who is that laughing?
Pups Save the Trick-or-Treaters: It's Halloween in Adventure Bay, and a mysterious kid in a giant spider costume is taking all the treats from the Trick-Or-Treaters! (S5, ep 16a) [SL]
Tim tries to get rid of a troublesome spider from his house.
A special spooky play is planned in 'Paddington and the Cursed Halloween Show', then in 'Paddington saves the Mooncake Festival', Taylor the lifeguard arrives in Windsor Gardens. (S3, ep 19)
Bibi wants a Marsupilami in 'Mar-Snoop', then in 'Canteen Carnage', the school chef quits after Jade leads a protest.
Uncle Tiberius comes to visit the Rexes, and Tim must be on his best behaviour.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia cannot decide on what the best gift could be for their grandmother.

When things go missing in Windsor Gardens, Jonathan believes a black hole is to blame, so Paddington goes on a space mission. Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of the rainbow after they break Baaz's kaleidoscope.
pr.sub: Paddington's Journey Into a Black Hole; Paddington's Rainbow Race!

pr.d: Redbeard the Elf Pirate sets sail to find the lost city, but soon finds himself in trouble and in need of rescuing.
It's the twins' birthday party and chaos ensues when their little friends arrive. The Wise Old Elf tries to entertain them, but they turn him into a mouse.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Paddington has a new friend in 'Paddington and the Caterpillar', then in 'The Floor is Lava', The Browns take part in a competitive game, but will they make a good impression on a visitor? (S2, ep 8)
Ben and Holly meet a new friend, Betty Caterpillar, but she is sad that she can't join in their games because she can't fly.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there, a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it.

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
When Tim and Kai have a rare disagreement, they each try to find a new best friend.
The Fruit Harvest: It is harvest day. The Elves and fairies enlist the help of Mr Gnome in picking blackberries. If only they could stop him from eating them all...
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Kai is super excited to ride the Nebulator, but Tim isn't so sure.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
Nanny Plum and the Wise Old Elf Swap Jobs For One Whole Day: Nanny Plum and The Wise Old Elf each think they work harder than the other. King Thistle commands them to swap for the day to find out.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Tim and Kai compete in a Star Hunt through Rumbleton.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
Grumblestunk's new speed camera catches Stan breaking the speed limit on his scooter, but he can't have been! Stan and Gran have to clear his name.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.
Stan and Gran get the giggles while spotting nature on the Ley, and the lake seems to be giggling back at them! Who is that laughing.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
The Crew Demolishes An Iceberg: The pups save Cap'n Turbot's boat when it gets stuck in ice, but then a huge iceberg floats into the way! Now it's up to the pups to bash the iceberg. (S5, ep 13)
The trainees meet a warlock in 'Into the Woods', then in 'All Creatures Great and Small', the trainees find they're stronger together.
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.
The children have adopted a new pet, a dragon named Dave. They did not know that he was going to grow and grow though and need to find him a place where he belongs.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
pr.sub: Mr. Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz

pr.d: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
Peppa loves cycling downhill, but is not so keen on pedalling uphill, so she insists everyone have a downhill race.
Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited. Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts. What can they be?
Peppa and Suzy are bored because they have nothing to do, so Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with, but not all the games are easy for little George.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works.
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig to the rescue.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
It's Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work, so while he's away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.
Daddy Pig is left behind when everyone takes Grampy Rabbit's little boat to the riverside picnic spot. Will someone remember him and save him some cake?
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George love helping Mummy Pig work on her computer, but they like playing computer games more.
The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Dr Hamster's pet tortoise, Tiddles, once again gets stuck on top of a tree, but everyone in the rescue team finds it tough to get the tortoise down.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but they have trouble deciding what to throw out because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything.

It's a beautiful day but Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching the motor racing on the television. Granny Pig shoos them all outside to enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy, but the room doesn't stay tidy for long though.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the Tortoise is very popular, but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit.
Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
The grass has grown so long that Peppa and George's ball gets lost in it. It falls to Grandpa to save the day with Betsy, his motorised lawnmower.
George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur, breaks. With all the additional features, surely Dino Roar is a good replacement?
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters to playgroup Peggy and Pandora Panda. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries just like their dad.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's friends. Grampy Rabbit lends them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
It's fruit day at the market and Miss Rabbit is making smoothies from people's favourite fruit. She gives George a special 'dinosaur' juice to make him big and strong.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and wishing well she's got for the garden. Peppa and George love them too, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. It makes him realise that he misses the sea after all.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed until they are told a story.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a much bigger team.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.
Everyone in Peppa's town is excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside the bin turn the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.
Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters to playgroup Peggy and Pandora Panda. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries just like their dad.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
To celebrate Freddy Fox's birthday, the children go on a trip to a Dinosaur Park. With Grampy Rabbit as their leader, they follow dinosaur footprints to find Freddy's birthday treat.

Everyone is down at the lake as it's a perfect day to go boating. Miss Rabbit has all sorts of boats for hire and Daddy Pig picks one with pedals, but when all the families have a race, he soon wishes he had picked something easier to sail.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.

It's time for playgroup, and Peppa and friends are thinking about what they want to be when they grow up. Some in the group want to be nurses, police officers and even pirates, but Peppa takes a little while to figure out what she wants to be.
Grandpa Pig pops round with some seeds for Peppa and George to plant, with Daddy Pig helping out by acting as a scarecrow.

Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining, but when George takes off his rain hat he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.

Grandpa and Granny Pig show and share with Peppa and George their toys and hobbies. Granny shows her special doll from childhood and Grandpa his love of building toy planes. Peppa and George have great fun when Grandpa reveals his new biggest plane ever that even George can fit in.

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play, and Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood.
When Mummy Pig helps out at Miss Rabbit's fire station, she is called upon to douse the flames at Daddy Pig's out-of-control barbecue.
Zoe Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa and George, an invitation to her birthday party.
Peppa and her family visit a new theme park where there is lots of fun to be had with vegetables.
Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses, and Peppa thinks she might need them too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.
Tiddles gets stuck in a tree and needs to be rescued. When the turtle falls on Pedro's nose, he needs to go to the doctors to make sure everything is OK.
Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again, Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.

Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep some old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young, but they are pleased to see that they have always been best friends.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van, even a chicken.
Peppa and George want to be famous detectives like their favourite television programme 'Detective Potato', so Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve.

Mr. Krabs Tochter erfährt einen Wachstumsschub und Mr. Krabs kommt kaum mit der Nahrungsmittelbeschaffung hinterher. SpongeBob bleibt in seiner Mangel stecken und seine Freunde versuchen mit allen Mitteln, ihn daraus zu befreien.
pr.sub: Der Wachstumsschub; In die Mangel genommen

pr.d: Chuck moves in with the Wylde-Paks after Lily and Jack accidentally destroy his house. They must hide his awful habits from their parents. Seeking closure on her favourite K-Drama, Lily films her own finale with her family as the cast and crew.
Plankton's family open a restaurant in 'Blood Is Thicker Than Grease', then in 'Don't Make Me Laugh', SpongeBob can't stop laughing. (S14, ep 4)

Plankton landet per Zufall in Sandys Badezimmer und stiehlt ihren Pelz, um sich als Sandy auszugeben. Plankton soll in Mr. Krabs Kopf eindringen. Leider geht der Plan schief und Plankton landet stattdessen in SpongeBobs Kopf.
The Groom & Board gets a surprise inspection, but the broken pipe Jack and Lil neglected to fix might ruin them all. Chuck's got a new hustle.
pr.sub: Just a Little Pipe Problem; Camp Chuck

pr.d: Alvin wants the lead role in a play in 'Best in Shoe', then in 'Royal Pain', Brittany becomes convinced she's a long lost princess, and carries her new royal status a little too far. (S4, ep 14)

Als Plankton klar wird, dass Fett ein Geschmacksträger ist, bricht zwischen ihm und Mr. Krabs ein Wettstreit aus, wer das fettigste Mahl zubereitet. SpongeBob hört ein Telefonat von Mr. Krabs mit und glaubt zu hören, dass der ihn loswerden will.
pr.sub: Schmierige Schlacht; Ein Schwamm will nach oben

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A consultant becomes Boss Baby's worst nightmare after arriving at Baby Corp with zany ideas and setting his sights on the CEO's job.
The Stinkwell skunks help the duo find 'The Disappearing Dung Ball', then in 'The Search for the Spotted Frog', Nature ranger Wally Bunker joins Sam and Kit to look for a pet frog. (S1, ep 6)

Thaddäus wird wegen Umweltverschmutzung zu gemeinnütziger Arbeit verurteilt und dabei wird sein Ehrgeiz geweckt. SpongeBob möchte Gary mit einem Haustier eine Freude machen, doch der Spielkamerad entpuppt sich als mörderisches Untier.

Patrick und SpongeBob müssen sich ein Spielzeug aus dem Kindermenü teilen und geraten aneinander. Mr. Krabs ist derweil für den Preis der geizigsten Krabbe nominiert und SpongeBob soll bei einer Ansprache seine Knausrigkeit darstellen.
pr.sub: Deins, meins und meins; Knickerige Knauserkrabben

pr.d: The Chaos Council returns to New Yoke City more powerful than ever, forcing the rebels to come out of the shadows and bring a fight to their front door.
A camping trip descends into chaos in 'Camping Chaos', then in 'A Hairy Situation', Twister's fur balls lead Stan to him. (S1, ep 15)

SpongeBob und Patrick werden vom Geist des fliegenden Holländers in Geister verwandelt und sind darüber nicht glücklich. Thaddäus und SpongeBob sollen sich in der Arbeit einen Spind teilen, doch SpongeBob verwandelt ihn in ein Lager.
Phoebe's powers combined with Max's are not enough to stop one of Max's old pranks from ruining a superhero gathering, prompting her to make a life-altering decision.
Googly Eyes: Gabby receives a jar of googly eyes that comes with a warning: "Don't shake the jar of googly eyes or you'll be in for a troublemaking surprise." (S3, ep 9)

Plankton will die Quallenfelder und die Krosse Krabbe abreißen lassen, um dort eine große Straße bauen zu lassen. SpongeBob kämpft dagegen an, schafft es allerdings nicht. Doch dann bekommt er Unterstützung aus der Natur.

Sparks fly between Phoebe and Cherry's visiting brother, prompting Cherry to grow concerned that she will be overshadowed by this new romance. After Cherry begs Phoebe not to date her brother, Phoebe must decide between love and friendship.

SpongeBob und Patrick machen versehentlich eine Zeitreise mit der Zeitmaschine von Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube. SpongeBob findet derweil eine Videokassette, auf der die verschollene Folge von Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube ist.
pr.sub: Früher war Früher früher; Der Böse-Jungs-Club für Superschurken

pr.d: Smurfette and Grouchy compete to decide who is the best in 'The Battle of the Sitters', and in 'Let's Smurf To Mars', Blossom dreams of going to Mars and can count on her friends to help. (S3, ep 11)
When Charlotte's invention for a TV show is accidentally destroyed and then rebuilt, Charlotte worries that the attention she gets could expose Kid Danger and Captain Man.

SpongeBob ist dafür bekannt, dass er viel und oft weint. Er schließt mit Thaddäus eine Wette ab, dass er es schaffen könnte, einen Tag nicht zu weinen. SpongeBob muss währenddessen einen Neuen in der Krossen Krabbe einarbeiten.
Dave enforces strict study rules after Alvin blames him for bad grades in 'Alvin Gets Schooled', then in 'My Life As a Dog', Theodore acts as a dog. (S5, ep 19)
Captain Man and Kid Danger find themselves in the middle of a debate about Swellview's favourite snack.

SpongeBob bewirbt sich in der Krossen Krabbe, außerdem reinigen SpongeBob und Thaddäus ihre Vorgärten, und SpongeBob ist bei Sandy zum Tee eingeladen. Allerdings gibt es in der Glaskuppel, in der sie wohnt, kein Wasser.
Rosa installs security cameras at the park, and people hate being spied on. When the Twins take the Marsupilamis to school, Stan spots Twister and claims a poisonous frog is loose to gain access.
pr.sub: Smile for the Camera; School Invaders

pr.d: The town is under attack when Simon creates a drone in 'Pizza Dash', then in 'Glory Days', the Chipmunks worry that they're making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star. (S3, ep 17)

SpongeBob eröffnet vor seinem Haus einen Stand zum Seifenblasen pusten und da Patrick am Anfang Schwierigkeiten beim Seifenblasen-Pusten hat, bietet er auch einen Anfängerkurs an, außerdem reißt SpongeBob bei einem Date mit Sandy die Hose.
pr.sub: Seifenblasen; Der Riss in der Hose

pr.d: SpongeBob und Patrick finden ein U-Boot, das zum fahrenden Restaurant umgewandelt wird. Patrick und SpongeBob lernen von der legendären Schlacht von Bikini Bottom, zu der es kam, weil sich die Beteiligten um Körperhygiene gestritten haben.
pr.sub: 20.000 Burger unter dem Meer; Die Schlacht von Bikini Bottom

pr.d: Handy has invented a machine that allows him to understand animals, but when Clumsy breaks it, the Smurfs must help out a very chatty bear!

Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car in 'Emotional Support Convertible', then in 'The Baseball', the trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back. (S3, ep 2)
Tired of not being able to defend himself, Wimpy decides having a dragon would solve his problems. Chef uses a cauldron from Papa Smurf's lab and accidentally brings it to life!
pr.sub: I Want a Dragon; Magic Meltdown

pr.d: SpongeBob denkt, dass er allen im Weg steht, und beschließt, die Stadt zu verlassen. Auf seinem Weg stürzt er und verliert sein Gedächtnis. Er startet in einer anderen Stadt ein neues Leben. Die Bewohner feiern ihn als "CheeseHead BrownPants".
Clumsy and Dimwitty open up a portal to other worlds.
Rock asks his friends to help him fly in 'Rock's Half-Birthday', then in 'Cherry Picking', Scissors feels left out of the group. (S3, ep 3)
Clumsy is desperate to take part in the Great Smurf Games and win the prize: a magic sphere that grants a wish to the winner.

SpongeBob und Patrick müssen Thaddäus helfen, der sich schwer verletzt hat und eine Not-OP braucht. Ein heftiger Sturm wirbelt das Leben in Bikini Bottom ganz schön auf. SpongeBobs Poren fangen an zu pfeifen, was Quallenschwärme anlockt.

When the girls at school develop a crush on the fire marshal, Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results; after causing an accident at a historic castle, Cheesy and Alvin work as reenactors to pay for the damage.
Will and Min have a disastrous date in 'Date Night', then in 'Behind the Jingle', the family writes a chart-topping jingle. (S2, ep 12)

Die Oberzicke Miss Duttfisch lässt das Burger braten in der Krossen Krabbe verbieten. Also eröffnet Mr. Krabs die Geheime Krosse Krabbe. SpongeBobs Cousin Stanley ist zu Besuch, und er stellt allerlei Chaos an, denn er ist ein echter Tollpatsch.
pr.sub: Burger braten verboten; Stanley S. Schwammkopf

pr.d: Alvin books the band at a birthday party only to discover they've been booked for the petting zoo as pets; Theodore invents an imaginary friend.

Double Trouble: Trust and teamwork are at an all-time low as Sonic goes against Chaos Sonic leaving Rebel Rogue and Renegade Knuckles to battle the supercharged Chaos Council forces alone. (S1, ep 14)

Thaddäus ist wütend und eifersüchtig auf Siegbert Schnösel, der in einer Fernsehshow auftaucht. Plankton wird aus dem Gefängnis entlassen und hat schon wieder einen geheimen Plan. Er will sich mit SpongeBob anfreunden, aber nicht ohne Hintergedanken.

SpongeBob findet einen Cent auf der Straße. Mr. Krabs beobachtet ihn dabei und will den Cent klauen. SpongeBob will unbedingt in einer Nacht alles über die Geschichte der Seefahrt lernen. Aber bald stößt er an seine Grenzen.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Boss Baby has an interview at Baby Corp, but he has to break out of a high-tech Bubbeezee playroom first; the field team strives to help him escape.
Theodore's teddy bear gets bear-napped in 'Switcheroo', and in 'The Paperboy', when Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay. (S3, ep 18)

Mr. Krabs braucht eine Attraktion für sein Restaurant und will sich in Stein meißeln lassen. Thaddäus hat als Künstler dafür genaue Vorstellungen, während Sandy versucht, Bikini Bottom vor dem Angriff der Wellhornschnecken zu bewahren.
pr.sub: Kunst und Krabbe; Verschleimt und verschlungen

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A party in the park drags the Boss Baby into a dogfight with his old nemesis, Puppy Co.'s Bug the Pug, and the loser must don the "Collar of Shame."
Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleep-overs in 'Theo's Big Night Out', then in 'The Bodyguard', Alvin decides he needs a personal bodyguard, and trains Theodore for the job. (S3, ep 24)

Dora und Boots suchen das Schiff der Piratenschweinchen und retten es vor dem Kraken. Dora und Boots helfen dem Häschen Bruno, seinen eigenen Tanzstil zu finden, um bei der Show seiner Lieblingsband, den Bunny Boyz, zu glänzen.
pr.sub: Kapitänin Dora / Bruno und die Bunny Boyz

pr.d: Rock, Paper and Scissors crash into Hollywood actor Henry Winkler's house, and they all go on a wacky adventure together. While trying to woo Pencil, Paper mistakenly ends up in a relationship he doesn't want with Potato.
pr.sub: The Henry Winkler Episode; Paper Loves Potato

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Lights, Camera, Org Chart: Boss Baby's leadership is challenged when a photographer selects other babies for a cover spread, while Tim continues to struggle with his solar system project. (S2, ep 5)

Tim probiert ein paar neue Raketenstiefel aus, aber die fliegen schnell in alle Richtungen. Tim, Tommy und Tia passen auf den Mondpapagei der Brontes auf. Tim, Tommy und Tia treten beim Fangball gegen ihre Eltern an.
Patrick and Squidina re-tape the family's home videos. Patrick spends a day with Cecil's brother.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: The Big Break: After breaking his arm, Boss Baby faces the real pain of Dr. Kevin's terrible jokes and rallies the playgroup to stop the doctor, while Tim gets obsessed with protecting him. (S2, ep 6)

1. Geschichte: Über Generationen hinweg erzählen sich die Schüler gegenseitig von der Legende des Rattenmonsters, das im Keller der Schule leben soll. Als plötzlich Stellas Spieluhr verschwindet, verdächtigen alle sofort das Rattenmonster. 2. Geschichte: Lincoln und Clyde können im Haus der Louds niemanden mehr finden und sind sofort davon überzeugt, dass sie es mit einer Zombie-Apokalypse zu tun haben!
The Krusty Krew get lazy when their mums take over the Krusty Krab. Patrick's new pet rock catches the eye of a mischievous rock collector.
Paper refuses to learn algebra in 'The Train Problem', then in 'Salmon Delivery for Ya', Rock pet sits for his boss, Franz Roll. (S3, ep 5)

Lincoln hat schreckliche Angst vor dem Elternabend und vor dem, was seine Lehrer über ihn erzählen könnten. Deshalb versucht er das anstehende Elterngespräch zu verschieben. Das darf doch nicht wahr sein: Ausgerechnet am Tag ihres ersten Dates mit Benny wacht Luan mit einem riesigen Pickel im Gesicht auf. Ob ihre Geschwister ihr helfen können, den Pickel rechtzeitig loszuwerden?
Patrick leaves his brain at home in 'Squidina and the Brain', then in 'Day of the Snail', Squidina pet sits Gary. (S6, ep 1)
Coach Dobbins kicks Cheesy and Theodore off the track team for being slow.
pr.sub: Between a Rope and a Hard Place; World Day

pr.d: SpongeBob und Thaddäus werden als Live-Act erfolgreich. // Cecil wird nach einem Unterwäsche-Unfall selbst Verkäufer.
Someone takes a chomp out of Bill and Jill's satellite van in the swamp; Sam and Kit investigate the strange shrieks keeping the bats awake in a cave.
pr.sub: The Case of the Big Chomp; The Secret of the Salt Cave

pr.d: Squidward's house becomes infested with a mail-order flea circus in 'Under the Small Top', then in 'Squidward's Sick Daze', Squidward fakes being sick, but SpongeBob arrives to care for him.

Patrick Star präsentiert eine Sendung über das Essen, nachdem er sein Frühstück verpasst hat. Außerdem gehen Patrick und SpongeBob gemeinsam auf Jobsuche und erfahren zum ersten Mal, wie es ist, auf dem Arbeitsmarkt zu arbeiten.
Stan lures the Marsupilamis with the scent from his 100-year orchid, and manages to catch all three. Marcel steals Gran Gran's recipe book after tasting Jade and Mica's delicious sandwich.
Another grocery trip devolves into chaos in 'The Real Woori World', then in 'The Collector', Jack pursues a rare collectible DVD. (S2, ep 10)

Paper macht Scissors ein schlechtes Gewissen, weil er seine guten Absichten nicht erreicht hat. Scissors versucht es zu schaffen. Um sich schlau zu fühlen, gründet Paper einen Buchclub mit den am wenigsten intelligenten Menschen, die er kennt.

Steins Vater kommt zu Besuch in die Stadt, und Stein beginnt im Familienunternehmen mitzuarbeiten, um seinen Vater endlich zu beeindrucken. Rock erhält eine Konfettibombe per Post und schwört sich, Rache an dem anonymen Bomber zu nehmen.
When Spongey-Saurus gets wet, he grows; when he dries out, he shrinks; Gabby and Pandy must find a way to keep their new dino-pal the perfect size.
Summer of Secrets: Chloe must attend summer school, and Max is assigned to be her teacher. While they will be busy all summer, Phoebe goes solo with a new superhero named Captain Perfect. (S2, ep 2)

Thaddäus und Blubber-Bass müssen sich auf einer Reise nach Muschelhausen gegenseitig ertragen. Thaddäus macht eine Reise in die Fantasiebox und muss sich auf die Kreativität von SpongeBob und Patrick verlassen, um zu entkommen.
Handy has invented a machine that enables him to understand animals. Clumsy and Dimwitty inadvertently open a portal to other worlds.
pr.sub: What the Bear Said; Parallel Worlds

pr.d: Jasper's Real Girlfriend: Jasper's summer camp girlfriend comes to town and stays with Charlotte. She quickly becomes jealous, thinking Charlottedis in love with Jasper. (S1, ep 26)

Plankton entdeckt das geheime Ersatzrezept für den Krabbenburger im Eimer. Er versucht den Eimer zu stehlen. Zudem entwickelt SpongeBob nach einem Unfall einen unkontrollierbaren Lachanfall, was alle im Krossen Krabben zur Verzweiflung treibt.

Theo's funky art project becomes a star with its own social media fans, which is great until the page is hacked; Dave writes a hit love song from a poem he found, but since Simon wrote the poem, he panics his secret will come out.
The Beat Goes On: With the return of Dr. Minyak, Henry finds himself in danger when he realizes that the evil doer has transformed his best friend, Charlotte, into an enemy. (S2, ep 1)

Ein heftiger Sturm führt dazu, dass die Krosse Krabbe ins Meer gespült wird, woraufhin Mr. Krabs schnell die Kontrolle übernimmt. Als neuer Kapitän steuert er das schwimmende Restaurant durch die Wellen. Die Krosse Krabbe beginnt ein neues Kapitel auf hoher See mit Mr. Krabs am Ruder.
pr.sub: Meuterei auf der Krusty; Auf den Zahn gefühlt

pr.d: Dave discovers he's not too good at roughing it outdoors when he goes on a day hike with the Chipettes. When Alvin pranks Simon with a trick website making it look like Alvin is smarter, the Chipettes prank Alvin back.
BlueDogSoda: When their favourite drink is banned, Sam and Cat begin making their own version instead. When they start selling it, the authorities come knocking at their door! (S1, ep 27)

Plankton und Karen streiten. Erneut gibt Plankton ihr die Schuld an seinem Unglück. Und erneut will er ihr beweisen, dass er auch ohne sie zurechtkommt. Doch wie immer scheitert Plankton dramatisch. Aber Karen hat ihn diesmal wirklich verlassen.
Ein Magier hypnotisiert Bobby. Ronnie Anne wundert sich, was mit dem Hotdog-Stand passiert ist.

Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together. Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000-year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant it.
pr.sub: Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Paper, Scissors; The Wish

pr.d: Lay Lay is the best friend anyone could ever want - but she's only an inspirational app. When Sadie makes a wish, Lay Lay is magically brought to life. Now, these two best friends can do anything!

Ronnie Anne und ihre Freunde helfen dabei, dass Frau Kernicky als neue Sportlehrerin eingestellt wird, aber ihr Unterricht ist kein Spaß. Als ein Geheimnis von Sid in der Schule auffliegt, stellen Ronnie Anne und Sid ihre Freundschaft infrage.

Paper and Sandpaper are on a train that gets hijacked by The Algebra Villain, who will make them crash unless Paper solves an algebra problem. Rock and Scissors think of the perfect prank call, but Rock bails to watch Franz Roll's pet, Kitty.
pr.sub: The Train Problem; Salmon Delivery for Ya

pr.d: Dog Day After-School: Desperate to get Mom's tablet back after it is confiscated at school, Billy and Nora get help from Phoebe, who wants to prove she can be as sneaky as Max. (S3, ep 18)

Lily beginnt, sich zu Hause schlecht zu benehmen und ihre Eltern schieben es auf ihre Freunde aus der Vorschule. Rusty wird ungerechterweise suspendiert. Das Action News Team ist allerdings zur Stelle, um seinen Ruf wiederherzustellen.

The family prepares for war, AKA a trip to the local Asian market. After their battle to procure a rare cookie, Jack feels more part of the family. The Groom & Board gets a bad review. Lily tries to find the culprit and corr.
Original Prankster: Despite promising his girlfriend he would stop pranking, Max pulls an epic gag which his friend is about to get expelled for. (S3, ep 21)

Lincoln, verkleidet als David Steele, macht sich auf die Suche nach seinem gestohlenen Geburtstagsgeschenk. Nachdem Luan eine Rolle in einer Inszenierung bekommen hat, muss sie diese Nachricht vor Frau Bernardo verheimlichen.
pr.sub: Ein Fall für Agent Steele / Erste Sahne

pr.d: The key to reassembling the Paradox Prism lies in one of the Shatterspaces. But Nine and Sonic must find a portal to safely transport the Shards there.
Henry & the Woodpeckers: When Piper's basketball coach quits, Henry becomes the coach of Piper's team. (S2, ep 4)

Nachdem Frida Kahlo 1925 im Alter von 18 Jahren bei einem Busunfall schwer verletzt worden ist, beginnt sie wie besessen zu malen. Mit dem Pinsel therapiert sie im Bett ihre psychischen und physischen Schmerzen. Gerade auf dem Weg der Besserung lernt sie Diego Rivera kennen und bittet ihn, ehrlich ihr Talent einzuschätzen. Er ist begeistert von ihrem Können - und auch von ihrer Schönheit. Bald schon heiraten sie und werden zu einem der aufregendsten Paare des 20. Jahrhunderts.

pr.t: The United States vs. Billie Holiday
pr.d: Die legendäre Jazzsängerin Billie Holiday gerät während ihrer Karriere immer wieder ins Visier der Behörden, weil ihr Song „Strange Fruit", der sich mit dem Lynchen von Afroamerikanern beschäftigt, als revolutionär und gefährlich eingestuft wurde. Das Federal Bureau of Narcotics lässt nichts unversucht, um das Leben der Sängerin auf den Kopf zu stellen. Billie Holiday weigert sich trotzdem, das Lied aus ihrer Setlist zu nehmen.

pr.t: The Miniaturist - Die Magie der kleinen Dinge
pr.d: Die Niederlande im Jahr 1686: Nella Oortmann hofft, in Amsterdam an der Seite ihres neuen Mannes ein neues Leben zu beginnen. Statt jedoch auf den versprochenen Edelmann Johannes trifft sie zunächst auf seine unterkühlte Schwester.

pr.t: The Miniaturist - Die Magie der kleinen Dinge
pr.d: Nella findet heraus, dass ihre Hochzeit auf einer Lüge aufgebaut ist und möchte Amsterdam verlassen. Marin und die Bediensteten können sie jedoch davon abhalten. Sie machen ihr deutlich, dass ihre Abreise eine Blamage für die Familie wäre.

pr.t: The Miniaturist - Die Magie der kleinen Dinge
pr.d: Nella will den Zuckerhandel selbst fortzuführen und Johannes damit retten. Doch im Gefängnis findet sie ihn in einer verzweifelten Lage vor. Frans muss vor Gericht gegen Johannes aussagen. Fraglich ist, ob Nella ihn freikaufen kann.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die emotionalen Liebes- und Familiengeschichten rund um das Personal und die Eigentümer des Luxushotels "Fürstenhof". Der Alltag wird bestimmt von tragischen Schicksalsschlägen, gemeinen Intrigen und turbulenten Liebschaften.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die emotionalen Liebes- und Familiengeschichten rund um das Personal und die Eigentümer des Luxushotels "Fürstenhof". Der Alltag wird bestimmt von tragischen Schicksalsschlägen, gemeinen Intrigen und turbulenten Liebschaften.

Friedrich beteuert gegenüber Barbara seine Unschuld, doch sie glaubt ihm kein Wort und sinnt stattdessen auf Rache. Als sie endlich den Vertrag findet, der beweist, dass Paulines Familie um ihr Erbe betrogen wurde, hat sie endlich das ersehnte Beweisstück in der Hand, um ihn finanziell zu ruinieren. Friedrich muss erkennen, dass Barbara eine Gegnerin ist, die man niemals unterschätzen darf. Als er beginnt, gegen sie vorzugehen, hat sie den Vertrag schon längst Werner zugespielt.

Werner ist sich bewusst, dass er mit dem Besitz des Vertrags Friedrich in der Hand hat und spielt kurz mit dem Gedanken, Pauline den Vertrag selbstlos zu überlassen. Stattdessen nutzt er ihn aber, um Friedrich dazu zu bringen, ihm 20 Prozent der Hotel-Anteile zu überlassen. Friedrich geht auf den Handel ein und meint, den drohenden Ruin abgewendet zu haben. Doch als er den Vertrag verbrennen will, kommt ihm Charlotte, die von Werner alarmiert wurde, in die Quere und stellt ihm ein Ultimatum.

Als Johannes Sonntag seine neue Wohnung betreten will, muss er feststellen: Er ist auf einen Betrüger hereingefallen. Denn die Wohnung, die er vor einigen Tagen angemietet hat, ist bereits vergeben - und das seit Jahren. Eine Schmach für den Leiter des Betrugsdezernats, denn Johannes ermittelt schon seit einiger Zeit gegen die sogenannten "Mietmarder", eine Bande von gerissenen Mietbetrügern.

Razzia auf der Galopprennbahn Berlin-Hoppegarten - zeitgleich mit Polizeiaktionen auf Pferderennbahnen im gesamten Bundesgebiet sind Julia und Johannes im Einsatz, um Dopingbetrüger zur Strecke zu bringen. Nadja Bock, Chefin der Polizeidirektion 7, ist mächtig unter Druck. Undenkbar, sollte Berlin als einziger Ort ohne Ergebnis dastehen! Doch die Befürchtungen von Bock scheinen sich zu bestätigen. Sie finden nichts!

Kaum ist Ben aus New York zurück, kauft er sich einen alten Chopper, mietet Gunters Werkstattschuppen und geht nach einem heißen Flirt mit Simone ins Bett. Härter hätte er Nachbar Thomas nicht treffen können. Carla versucht vergeblich, Torben von Noras Spur abzubringen. Es fällt ihr schwer, ihn anzulügen, doch ihn einzuweihen ist auch unmöglich.

Lasse beweist sich als versierter Astrologie-Kenner, als er nur anhand von Noras Charaktereigenschaften ihr Sternzeichen errät. Leider ist es das ihrer wahren Identität. Als Torben eine Sternzeichen-Löwe-Kette bei Nora findet, obwohl sie offiziell im Mai geboren ist, wird er wieder misstrauisch. Ist Nora wirklich diejenige, die sie behauptet? Derweil ist Volker wie vom Blitz getroffen, als er Nora zum ersten Mal in Lüneburg begegnet.

Mirko Kowalski, ein junges Box-Talent, ist auf bestem Weg ins Profilager. Doch bei einem Trainingskampf wird er schwer getroffen und in die Sachsenklinik eingeliefert. Hier kümmert sich Dr. Brentano um ihn. Anscheinend nicht gründlich genug, denn er übersieht einen Milzriss. - Mirkos Vater Ernst, der auch sein Trainer und Manager ist, macht sich große Sorgen um seinen geliebten Sohn.

Im Foyer der Sachsenklinik begegnet die Sachbearbeiterin Madeleine Hagen dem Patienten Ingo Rottmann. Die beiden verlieben sich auf den ersten Blick ineinander. Sie findet ihn äußerst attraktiv, obwohl oder gerade weil er sich etwas linkisch und ungeschickt durch die Welt bewegt. Madeleine tut alles, um ständig bei Ingo Rottmann zu sein. Der erwidert ihre Gefühle, hat aber Schwierigkeiten, sich jetzt auf eine Beziehung einzulassen.

Fanol Komani ist wegen Diebstahl und Körperverletzung angeklagt. Das Opfer erkennt während der Gerichtsverhandlung Komani eindeutig als Täter. Aber Richter Greinert versucht mit allen Mitteln, den Zeugen Weigand zu verunsichern.

Markus Gellert muss seine Tochter Marleen vor dem Gefängnis bewahren. Marleen ist verhaftet worden. Sie soll in der vergangenen Nacht einen Fußgänger angefahren und dann Fahrerflucht begangen haben. Marleen kann sich an nichts mehr erinnern.

Mariannes beste Freundin Vera will heiraten. Doch im Brautmodengeschäft bricht Veras Bräutigam Konstantin zusammen. In der Klinik wird multiples Organversagen aufgrund einer Blausäurevergiftung festgestellt. Konstantin fällt ins Koma, schwebt in Lebensgefahr. Wie konnte die giftige Substanz in Konstantins Körper gelangen? Konstantin arbeitet zu Hause als Übersetzer, lebt gesund und kauft im Ökoladen ein.

Als Jürgen und Patrick Klug versuchen, die 18-jährige Mia Kulick wegen Schwarzfahrens zu verhaften, droht diese, sich umzubringen. Gemeinsam können Vater und Sohn verhindern, dass das Mädchen sich mit einer zerbrochenen Bierflasche verletzt. Im Dezernat versucht Julia Klug, das Vertrauen von Mia zu gewinnen. Aber die junge Frau ist genauso verstockt wie verzweifelt.

Torben lässt der Fall `Nora Franke' keine Ruhe, sehr zum Leidwesen von Carla. Als er von der angeblich 70-jährigen `Nora Franke' angerufen wird, bleibt er misstrauisch und will sie sehen. Gerade als er auf der Suche nach ihr aufbrechen will, steht die ominöse alte Nora Franke vor seiner Tür. Auch Volker will vorerst in Lüneburg bleiben, weil ihn Nora sehr interessiert. Als Alibi verlängert er seine Beratertätigkeit bei Thomas im Rathaus.

Mithilfe einer ehemaligen Beamtin vom LKA, die sich als 70-jährige Nora Franke ausgibt, kann Torben beruhigt werden. Carla und Nora sind froh, dass Torben seine Verdächtigungen endlich einstellt. Nora bietet Lasse an, im Campingbus übernachten zu können, wofür er dankbar ist. Als er aber zufällig einen Streit in der Hotel-Lobby zwischen der Schlagerdiva Betty Kayser und ihrem Manager-Mann Joey schlichten will, wird Nora zu Boden geschubst und Lasse reagiert sehr merkwürdig.

Werner geht auf Rosalies Angebot ein, Felix zu beeinflussen. Er wird in seinen Träumen von Barbara heimgesucht und will sich von Evelyn ein leichtes Schlafmittel verschreiben lassen. Alfons sieht eine Frau, die Barbara zum Verwechseln ähnlich sieht.

Die blonde Sylvia Wielander hat eine erstaunliche Ähnlichkeit mit Barbara. Werner alarmiert die Polizei, und die Spekulationen am Hotel überschlagen sich. Sylvia weiß nicht, wie ihr geschieht, doch Felix glaubt ihr ihre Geschichte nicht.

Der kleine Savill Kent wird grausam ermordet aufgefunden. Der Fall schlägt Wellen in ganz England. Der Innenminister veranlasst, dass Inspektor Whicher von der Metropolitan Police nach Wiltshire geschickt wird, um den Mord aufzuklären.
pr.sub: Der Mord von Road Hill House

pr.d: Mr. Whicher lernt Susan Spencer in einem Pub kennen, in dem sie offensichtlich völlig fehl am Platz ist. Sie ist auf der Suche nach ihrer schwangeren Nichte Mary Spencer. Kurz darauf wird die junge Frau ermordet aufgefunden und der Verdacht fällt sofort auf den Vater ihres Kindes, Stephen Gann, der laut Zeugenaussagen nichts mehr von ihr wissen wollte.
pr.sub: Der Mord in der Angel Lane

pr.d: Zwei Frauen werden ermordet aufgefunden. Ihre einzige Gemeinsamkeit ist die Heiratsvermittlung, die sie besuchten. Gréco schmiedet einen Plan, um den Mörder zu fassen und meldet sich kurzerhand selbst bei der Heiratsvermittlung an.
pr.sub: Bis dass der Tod uns scheidet

pr.d: Das Adlon ist das Luxushotel der Hauptstadt. Ein neues Haus am alten Ort, ein Mythos lebt wieder auf: Marlene Dietrich, Hans Albers, Charlie Chaplin, Mary Pickford, Thomas Mann und Albert Einstein standen im alten Adlon auf der Gästeliste. 1907 weiht Kaiser Wilhelm II. das Haus ein und es wird seine heimliche Herberge. "Kinder geht doch lieber ins Adlon, im Schloss ist es kalt und im Bad geht das heiße Wasser nicht", empfiehlt er seiner Familie.

Normalerweise nehmen sie dieses Naturereignis gelassen zur Kenntnis. Doch diesmal ist es anders. Der Wetterbericht kündigt einen Megasturm an: Xaver soll die Hallig mit Orkanstärke treffen. Wasserstände von bis zu vier Meter über Normal werden vorhergesagt.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.

Fred and Rose West raped, tortured and murdered at least a dozen young British girls between 1967 and 1987, including several of their own daughters. Learn how two of Britain's most notorious serial killers were able to get away with their crimes for so long, how they hid the victim's remains within the confines of their own home, and how they were eventually taken down.
When hardware store clerk Sydney Loofe vanishes after an online date, investigators race against the clock to find her. But as the days wear on, a horrible truth emerges from the darkness.
In a tiny hamlet just outside the town of Bonnyville, Alberta, Canada, 58-year-old Doreen Bradley, owner and operator of a successful fast food restaurant, is found murdered in her rural home.

Fredrick Banks is an eccentric senior who loves to show off his vintage cars and wallet stuffed with cash. When he is found slain in his garage, authorities hunt for the mysterious stranger who has recently been spotted lurking in town.

A fire engulfs the home of the Klaus family in the middle the night while everyone is asleep, and the investigators suspect that it isn't an accident. The whole case changes when the son starts seeing the spirits of his dead family.

When Abbie Speir's body is pulled from her burning house in a quaint farming community, investigators quickly discover that the fire is no accident, and that a killer could be lurking closer to home than anyone can imagine.
When the body of a young girl is found, the paedophile living nearby is the prime suspect. This inspired Sarah's Law, which grants the UK public information on sex offenders.
Inside Justice investigates the conviction of Glyn Razzell, found guilty of his wife's murder. Glyn maintains his innocence, and now there's an alleged link with a double murderer.
This is the chilling but little-known story of Trevor Hardy, the serial killer known as the 'Beast of Manchester' who murdered three teenage girls between December 1974 and March 1976.

The Manson Family, led by Charles Manson, committed a set of crimes that terrified the world and brought the flower power movement to a halt. Charles Milles Manson was an American criminal and musician who led the Manson Family, a cult based in California.
Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they 'got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.

Kenneth Kunz finds four of his family members murdered and one missing. Investigators must determine whether it was his mother, a local farm boy, or the rumoured family drug dealing connections that led to the brutal slayings.

The chief of police leads an investigation into what happened to his family friend and babysitter, who is reported missing when she doesn't come home from Christmas shopping, and is found beneath a snow bank weeks later.
A young police officer discovers the dark secret hidden in a neighbourhood restaurant.

When Erin Chorney disappears, suspicion falls on her ex-boyfriend Michael Bridges, the last person to have seen her. After investigators' searches come up empty-handed, they orchestrate an operation to woo Bridges into confessing her whereabouts.

On the outskirts of Nashville, Mich., Rodney Fancher's bullet-ridden body is found in a ditch. The hunt for a killer begins, pulling in police forces from across the state. As the case starts to turn cold, a startling confession emerges.
Laura usually gets her way, and Alberto will do anything to keep her happy. However, when he falls on hard times, Laura takes matters into her own hands.
Roger and Lisa plan a quiet weekend away to hide their tracks from the police. But will their desire to escape lead to deadly choices that they'll regret?
Nursing student Taiana falls for rising rap star Terry Sellers. But their hot and heavy drug-fuelled romance turns a romantic getaway into a murderous crime spree.
When addict Casey falls for compulsive con-woman Jo, the combustible couple gets wrapped up in a series of scams for which their only escape is murder.
When Bo meets C.J. Harvey at a truck stop, he gets more than just a ride home. Soon their friendship spirals out of control and ends in an armed stand-off with police.
Seemingly normal couple Karla Homolka and Paul Bernardo murdered two teenage girls together, but would their dedication to one another last through the trial?
Exploring Hindley's childhood and the start of her relationship with Brady.
The stories of Brady and Hindley's five known murder victims and accounts of the children who got away.
Brady and Hindley continue to taunt Keith Bennett's family by refusing to reveal where his body is buried. And Hindley's relentless campaign to shift public opinion and win further obscure the truth.

pr.d: In a small pocket of Donegal woodland, solicitor Killian McLaughlin will attempt to turn back the hands of time and return wolves, brown bears, Eurasian lynx, wild boar and many other animals that have become extinct to Ireland.

pr.t: Return of the Wild: The Bearman of Buncrana
pr.d: Passion drives solicitor Killian McLaughlin to create a unique wildlife park in Co Donegal, which will offer sanctuary to abused brown bears and other rescue animals before returning them to their forest habitats once more.

pr.t: Return of the Wild: The Bearman of Buncrana

Sherlock ermittelt im Mordfall des Umzugsunternehmers Leland Frisk. Die Ermittlungen ergeben, dass er eigentlich ein Auftragskiller war. Sherlock findet schnell Hinweise, wer der Täter sein könnte, da Frisk über jeden Kunden eine Akte angelegt hatte.

Nach einem Brand wird die verkohlte Leiche eines Mannes gefunden. Der Tote war Brandexperte und wurde erschossen, bevor das Feuer ausbrach. Die Polizei vermutet daher, dass ein Serien-Brandstifter hinter der Tat steckt, dem er auf der Spur war.

Ein erschossener Hacker wird in seiner Wohnung gefunden, doch der wahre Tatort liegt in einem Freizeitpark. Als plötzlich Castles geheimnisvoller Vater auftaucht, wendet sich das Blatt, denn das Opfer half ihm bei einer Bundesangelegenheit.

Eine Hochzeit endet mit einem Toten. Jane vermutet, dass einer der Gäste der Täter ist. Doch anscheinend geht es um etwas ganz anderes: Eine sehr wertvolle Bibel wurde gestohlen. Trotz allem wird die Hochzeit durchgezogen.

In das Büro von Patrick Jane wurde eingebrochen. Die Liste mit Red John-Verdächtigen ist weg. Kurz darauf ist ein Mann von genau dieser Liste tot. Lisbon hat einen schlimmen Verdacht. Werden jetzt alle Männer auf dieser Liste umgebracht?
